description: Convert a Word (.docx) file — or pasted text — into a clean, printable PDF. Text content is preserved; complex formatting is simplified.

faqs.a: Only the text content is carried over, rendered in a clean layout. Fonts, colors, tables and images from the original are simplified or dropped.
faqs.q: Does it keep my Word formatting?

faqs.a: Yes. The .docx format is a zip of XML files; older binary .doc files use a different format this tool cannot read. Save as .docx first.
faqs.q: Why won't my old .doc file work?

faqs.a: You can. Leave the file picker empty and paste or type your text into the box instead, then convert.
faqs.q: Can I convert text without uploading a file?

howto: Choose a .docx file — or paste text directly into the box instead.
The text is extracted and laid out as a clean PDF.
title: Word to PDF
